shared_elements: schematic curvilinear/hooked motif carved or marked on a stone surface
isolated non-figurative shapes set against a plain field
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry simplified, curvilinear low-relief/marked shapes with no naturalistic detail, which is a generic trait rather than a specific iconographic match. A shows an organised vertical scheme on a monumental anthropomorphic form \u2014 a head, arched crescent motifs, spirals and a prominent ring/disc arranged in registers \u2014 while B shows a single ambiguous hooked or forked shape floating alone with none of these motifs or their stacked relationships.
